book.name: Pilipai
book.title: Pilipai Pâlaŋ Pilipai dapmelaŋge ekŋengat zapat meluwaŋ kapi kumindaye.

content: Eksemti mamayet Pâlaŋ aŋkeŋoo zet diindoye

Kilaismagen notnne, in kot indidigat keŋŋ temaŋ penaŋ matazin ma neŋ ingat gogot mamiap. Neŋ ingat tuŋguwinan mulup mma in nâmkiŋpepe aikbien keyet neŋ oloŋen mimindemti am ekŋengat zikalinan sekŋin mamotindeyap. Kogogapm notnne dolakŋaŋ penaŋ, in Amobotnaŋ Zisas ekmagen wetekumti gweŋgweŋ kumti katikŋaŋ matapmambep.
Imbi zut Yuodiamak ma Sintiki it Amobotnaŋ ekmagen nâmkiŋpepeŋit kwep tazin keyet mti it tuŋguwidan zet mmot mtot bugan tazin e pemalu tapme keŋ kwep bemti mambalup.

Kegok mmalu mulup an notn penaŋ geŋ imbi zut ke idikdamuŋ dolakŋaŋ mmane mambalup. Eget ma Kelemen ma am notnaŋ Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋgat napmukulem mti zempalakŋaŋ bemebien. Ekŋen ke kwilin mama kanzizitgalen papiaen ilak kumpepeŋaŋaŋ tazin.
In Amobotnaŋgat oloŋen mti sesewatsapeŋ mamambep zet ewe ikŋaŋ keyegak sakwalamti zema nâit. In Amobotnaŋgat oloŋen mti sesewatsapeŋ mamambep.
Nâip, Amobotnaŋ ilak kokogalen kan sokŋanik bein keyet in am bakbak mimindemti nâmkiŋpepeen indamukulem mimindewep.
In kwileki ŋeniyet olati keyet yayaŋ temaŋ ku mbep. In belak nânâŋin ke Amobotnaŋ zikat same egaŋ ŋep indamukulem mbe. Âpme in mukulemaŋ ke ekti egat wisikŋ kan kataŋ zepeŋ mamambep.

Nin Kilais Zisasmak tususunn tazin keyepmti Kawawaŋ keŋ sewakŋaŋ toŋaŋ egaŋ tuŋgupmnanen keŋ sewak temaŋ manndain. Keŋ sewak keboŋ ke am nin yaŋaŋ ŋep ku nâmâtâtâgalen. Keŋ sewak keyaŋ keŋin sekŋin damuŋ mimindeme kakanemuŋ mambep.

Notnne, zet delaŋ zenzeŋaŋ pigok met zema nâit, in keŋinan kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ dolakŋaŋ etaŋ wizinzimpemti mama mimiŋin esemteŋ ma kwetetepmaŋ mti am sambe bepi gogot etaŋ mimindamti mame am ekŋenaŋ indikti Kawawaŋgat kwizet buŋamaŋ mwabep.
Mama mimi dolakŋaŋ ekŋen kapi neŋ zemti mkwapma ekti eknom mme delaŋ zeye. Keyegak mti mame Kawawaŋ keŋ sewak toŋaŋaŋ indikme dolakŋaŋ beme inmak mambe.
Pâlaŋ Pilipai dapmelaŋge ekŋenaŋ taolet notnaŋ beme mepme ekti oloŋen mge

In eweŋan nâgât milawatn ŋen ewe ŋep ke beme kotnakgalenaŋgut ilinmagen kambeŋ temaŋ takwapme olat olat palen mamkwabien keyepmti ku beme koge. Yaŋ alak pi in nâgât nâmti tewalaŋ ewe beme kozin keyepmti neŋ ingat keŋ dolak omba penaŋ nâmindemti Amobotnaŋ sesewatpeyap.
Wa neŋ âŋ zet mti zet kapi ku kumindayap. Neŋ kwileki notnaŋgat omtimat timat palen mamti keyet ku manâmbekambeyap.

Neŋ kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ sambe wem name mamayet ma olat olat palen mamayet ilizuzut nâma ŋep penaŋ mambein. Nim nalak nalak mti mama ma kambeŋ palen mama ma nimwiaŋ wiaŋ palen mama ma meuyet tip alaŋ nâpeŋ mama ekŋen ke yaŋaŋ mnâmti mama sekŋ beye.
Kilaisiyaŋ winde name windemak mamayap ma egalen windeyet neŋ kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ sambe bee ŋep mmâbap.
Yaŋgut neŋ olat olat palen manepema in napmukulem mnewien keyepmti neŋ ingat nâma dolakŋaŋ penaŋ bein.

Pilipai mkaengatnaŋ am in ilin nâip. Neŋ Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋgat mulup yaŋbemti Masedonia msat pemti mulup mmebanen dapmelaŋge notnaŋ ekŋenaŋ belak mame in etaŋ segeset napmukulem mkwabien.
Ma neŋ Tesalonaika msalen met mulup mamimtemanen in napmukulem mti segeset bandim omba penaŋ mamnamkwatemien.
Wa mânep milawat keyet etaŋ nâmti ku zeyap. Mama mimi dolakŋaŋ ke inmagen temaŋ penaŋ tasokbein keyet eyo nâmti zeyap. In ewe kegok mmebewen keyet tosaŋaŋ Kawawaŋaŋ temaŋ indawe.

In nâgât taolet omba penaŋ Epapolodaitas same timkot name tim elimiakti tapmayap. Taolelin beme koge kapi Kawawaŋgat soŋgom sâpe sâpe bume zim pilik sesikŋaŋ dolakŋaŋ mapemtan sepem kegok bein. Sâpe sâpe keboŋ ke Kawawaŋaŋ ekme dolakŋaŋ penaŋ beme oloŋen temaŋ penaŋ mamin.
Kawawaŋ ek kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋaŋ sambe penaŋ tazingapm in Zisas Kilaismak tusumti mamaip keyepmti in olat olat palen mame egaŋ kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ sambe ketalasim indame in tim nimwiaŋ mambep.
Am sambeyaŋ Geŋ Kawawaŋ Bipm kwizet buŋamdi mwagemti sesewatgapeŋ mamambep. Ke penaŋ.
Zet zemdelaŋ zenzeŋaŋ
Neŋmak notnne notnaŋ am nâmkiŋpepemak pien mamanup nin Zisas Kilais egat mti ingat otnâpeŋ mamanup keyet mti in am nâmkiŋpepemak noline notnaŋ ekŋen diindome nâmbep.
Pien am nâmkiŋpepemak notnaŋ gapman temaŋ egalen mkaen mulup mamip ekŋenaŋ in kegogak indamukumindeip.
Neŋ Ambotnaŋ Zisas Kilaisiyaŋ in keŋ taolet mimindandayet nâmti mandunduyap.
